svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "The structure of DNA."], [1, "Two backbones of sugar and phosphate, running in opposite directions (antiparallel)."], [3, "Bases pair across the middle: a purine (two rings) always pairs with a pyrimidine (one ring), so every rung is the same width."], [8, "A\u2013T are joined by 2 hydrogen bonds, G\u2013C by 3."], [11, "The ladder twists into a double helix."]]
svg.title: DNA structure and base pairing
svg.desc: A DNA ladder with antiparallel sugar–phosphate backbones, purines pairing with pyrimidines, two hydrogen bonds between A and T and three between G and C, twisting into a double helix.
svg.text: Purines (A, G): two rings. Pyrimidines (T, C): one ring.

g.data-info: Deoxyribose sugars joined by phosphates (phosphodiester bonds) form the outside of each strand.
A pairs with T by 2 hydrogen bonds; G pairs with C by 3. Weak individually, strong together; easy to separate for copying.
The ladder twists: about 2 nm wide, about 10 base pairs and 3.4 nm per complete turn.

g.text: Purine + pyrimidine = same width for every pair
